style: Close-up surface materials of everyday objects and props, neutral light colours so they can be tinted in the game.

cells.name: white-plastic
cells.prompt: Slightly textured white ABS plastic with fine moulded stipple and faint scuffs.

cells.name: black-plastic
cells.prompt: Black textured ABS plastic with fine stipple and light scratches, shown lit so the texture is visible.

cells.name: matte-plastic
cells.prompt: Matte light-grey injection-moulded plastic with a soft orange-peel texture.

cells.name: gloss-paint
cells.prompt: Glossy light-grey painted surface with very faint orange peel and tiny dust specks.

cells.name: painted-metal
cells.prompt: Light-grey powder-coated metal with fine texture, small chips and edge wear.

cells.name: brushed-metal
cells.prompt: Light brushed metal with fine straight brushing lines.

cells.name: cotton-cloth
cells.prompt: Light grey woven cotton fabric with visible threads.

cells.name: plastic-crate
cells.prompt: Ribbed moulded plastic crate side: vertical ribs, handle cut-out shapes and small vents.

cells.name: gold-leaf
cells.prompt: Light gold-leaf surface with subtle hammered texture and fine cracks.
